entities.summary: Luis David Montero Carrasco is a Dominican professional basketball player for Cocodrilos de Caracas of the Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto (SPB). He was considered one of the top National Junior College Athletic Association players in the United States while at Westchester Community College in Valhalla, New York.

entities.summary: Luis David Montero Carrasco is a Dominican professional basketball player for Cocodrilos de Caracas of the Superliga Profesional de Baloncesto (SPB). He was considered one of the top National Junior College Athletic Association players in the United States while at Westchester Community College in Valhalla, New York.
